plan: Given my private value of $9, I should bid conservatively to avoid overpaying. My goal is to win only if the third-highest bid is significantly lower than my value. I will bid slightly above half of my value to increase the chance of winning while minimizing the risk of paying too much. This approach maximizes potential profit if I win and minimizes loss if I lose. Hence, I will bid $5.

Given my value of $40, I aim to bid close to maximize my profit while ensuring I win. Assuming others bid around their value or slightly lower, I'll bid slightly above half my value to outbid a potential middle bid. This minimizes risk and maximizes profit if I win. I'll bid $25 to balance winning chances and profit margin, considering the third-highest bid will likely be much lower than my value.

My value is $32. To maximize profit, I must bid below this value to ensure a net gain if I win. I will bid slightly below my value to increase my chances of winning while minimizing the cost.
